Shipped model `include50` (from `transformer_include50`): ONNX fp32 2.40 MB, int8 0.80 MB. On the 192 test videos: PyTorch vs ONNX fp32 max logit difference 2.9e-06; fp32 vs int8 top-1 agreement 100.0%; accuracy fp32 97.9%, int8 97.9%.

Model choice, fixed before any test number was seen: higher val accuracy, ties broken by lower val loss at the best checkpoint (`gru_include50` 0.175, `transformer_include50` 0.088). The test split never influenced training or the choice.

Softmax temperature: not fitted (degenerate fit (val errors: 0, optimum 0.2358 at the grid edge)); the app uses 1.0. It needs a validation set the model makes mistakes on (not the consented recordings, which are for accuracy measurement only).

Session-independent, inferred signer-independent and real-webcam numbers are not measured yet (Future work). Browser latency and fps are reported only with the device they were measured on.
